title: Mexico Asks Washington to Detain and Extradite the Wife of Genaro García Luna
author: Sugeyry Romina Gándara
content:
_This article by Sugeyry Romina Gándara originally appeared in the[September
4, 2026 edition of SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4865089/mexico-pide-
a-washington-que-detenga-y-extradite-a-la-esposa-de-genaro-garcia-luna/), a
Mexican independent news outlet._

Mexico City, September 4 (SinEmbargo).— President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo
confirmed on Friday that there is a request from the Mexican government to the
United States to detain and extradite Linda Cristina Pereyra, wife of former
security secretary Genaro García Luna.

> It is part of an investigation that has been going on for some time by the
> Attorney General’s Office.
>
> President Claudia Sheinbaum
